YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

][137]

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

For over 40 years, Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories have provided end-to-end support for drug

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

For over 40 years, Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories have provided end-to-end support for drug

# We are Committed to Life

[More][106]
[

### Vision

We strive to transform Fresenius Kabi in the decade to come. We are committed to increase
efficiencies in the therapy and care of patients and improve access to high-quality healthcare
around the globe.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][107]
[

### Excellence

We are specialized in lifesaving medicines and technologies for critically and chronically ill
patients. With our passion and expertise, we touch the lives of almost 450 million people every
year, each one representing the importance of our work.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][108]
[

### Sustainability

We constantly strive to improve our sustainability footprint. For us, meeting the needs of patients
and healthcare professionals goes hand in hand with responsible and ethical management.

[nurse taking hand of woman]
][109]
[

### Think Beyond: Latest Evidence for Effective Therapies in CKD

Join experts at the Global Renal Nutrition Webinar on June 16, 2026. Explore ERA 2026 insights,
protein‑reduced diets, and targeted CKD nutrition.
[Global Kidney Nutrition Webinar Key Visual]
][110]
[

### Women Who Shaped Us

At Fresenius Kabi, colleagues worldwide share personal stories for International Women’s Day,
honoring the women who shaped their courage and purpose.
[Images of Fresenius Kabi employees being interviewed on international womens day.]
][111]
[

### Fresenius Kabi recognized as a Top Employer in 13 countries

Fresenius Kabi has been certified by Top Employers Institute as a Top Employer for 2026 in 13
countries and additionally two regions.
[Image showing the top employer 2026 seals of the 13 countries and 2 regions.]
][112]
[

### Four Colleagues, Four Scientific Journeys: Voices of Women in Science

Female scientists from Biopharma, MedTech, Nutrition and Pharma share their stories and advice,
showing how science careers impact patient care and innovation.
[Image of women in science.]
][113]
[

### Meet The Heroes Behind Patient Safety

Unseen heroes ensure patient safety through precision, care, and smart tech at Fresenius Kabi.
Discover how people make the difference.
[Several people in different job roles like production and lab workers depicted as heroes with capes
and gadgets.]
][114]

# Advancing science.
# Amplifying impact.

[ What We Do ][201]

Grifols is a leading global healthcare company. Our trusted and innovative plasma-derived medicines,
other biopharmaceuticals and solutions in transfusion medicine enable millions of patients around
the world to lead more productive lives.

Since our founding in 1909, our ever-growing mastery of plasma, diagnostics and life sciences,
backed by our ethical leadership and industry-leading quality and safety standards, have contributed
to a healthier and more sustainable society.

## TIME and Forbes rank us among the world’s best companies

TIME magazine has recognized Grifols as one of the world’s top companies for the third consecutive
year. Additionally, for the second year in a row, Forbes has named Grifols one of the World’s Best
Employers.

This achievement reflects our relentless commitment to our people and long-term impact.

## Barcelona honors Víctor Grífols i Lucas

The Barcelona City Council has named the street where the company’s institutional headquarters is
located after Víctor Grífols i Lucas. This tribute recognizes a pioneer in the biomedical industry
who, for more than six decades, was the heart and driving force behind Grifols. Uncover the story
behind Grifols’ legacy.

[ Read more ][206]

## Commitment to people and the planet

Aligned with the United Nations plan to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals defined in its
2030 Agenda, we work every day to do more and do better to contribute to the health and quality of
life of people around the world.

The patients we serve are able to lead better lives. Patients inspire the work we do every day.

[ Read more ][207]
Innovation

## Scientific innovation at work

Our deep and expanding knowledge of plasma and the life sciences is helping us better understand
human health and research potential treatments to improve it.

[ Read more ][208]

## Get to know us

Our history

We trace our roots back to 1909 when Dr. Josep Antoni Grifols i Roig founded a clinical analysis
laboratory in Barcelona, the precursor to Laboratorios Grifols.

other key stakeholders whose trust we value. We are committed to being a good corporate citizen and
take responsibility to proactively identify and manage the environmental, social and governance
risks and opportunities that are relevant to our business and those we serve.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

## **Get Compensated For Your Time**

Plasma can’t be made in a lab. So, people with rare and complex diseases rely on donors like you to
live fuller lives. Knowing you’re helping others is the best feeling in the world. And getting paid
for your time is a great way to boost your budget.

[BioLife Debit Card. When you donate, you'll receive compensation on a BioLife Debit Card that works
wherever Debit Mastercard is accepted.]

####  

#### **BioLife Debit Card**

When you donate, you’ll receive compensation on a BioLife Debit Card that works wherever Debit
Mastercard is accepted.

[Buddy Bonus. You can also receive extra funds with our Buddy bonus when you refer a friend to
donate plasma.]

####  

#### **Buddy Bonus**

You can also receive extra funds with our Buddy Bonus when you refer a friend to donate plasma.

Learn More

## **What is Plasma Donation?**

##### Often referred to as “liquid gold,” plasma is the pale, yellow liquid that makes up about 55%
##### of your blood.

We separate plasma from your blood using a process called plasmapheresis. The plasma is then used to
produce various treatments and therapies. Since our bodies replenish plasma so easily, donation is
both a safe and admirable choice for donors.

Learn More
[BioLife healthcare professional attending to a smiling donor.]

Some diseases can only be treated with medicines made with plasma. Since plasma can’t be made

## **Get Compensated For Your Time**

Plasma can’t be made in a lab. So, people with rare and complex diseases rely on donors like you to
live fuller lives. Knowing you’re helping others is the best feeling in the world. And getting paid
for your time is a great way to boost your budget.

[BioLife Debit Card. When you donate, you'll receive compensation on a BioLife Debit Card that works
wherever Debit Mastercard is accepted.]

####  

#### **BioLife Debit Card**

When you donate, you’ll receive compensation on a BioLife Debit Card that works wherever Debit
Mastercard is accepted.

[Buddy Bonus. You can also receive extra funds with our Buddy bonus when you refer a friend to
donate plasma.]

####  

#### **Buddy Bonus**

You can also receive extra funds with our Buddy Bonus when you refer a friend to donate plasma.

Learn More

## **What is Plasma Donation?**

##### Often referred to as “liquid gold,” plasma is the pale, yellow liquid that makes up about 55%
##### of your blood.

We separate plasma from your blood using a process called plasmapheresis. The plasma is then used to
produce various treatments and therapies. Since our bodies replenish plasma so easily, donation is
both a safe and admirable choice for donors.

## Welcome to Biomedical Microdevice Lab in HKUST!

We are in the pursuit of advanced microfluidic devices to address practical issues in life science
and medicine. Our research interests primarily include siliconbased fabrication, nucleic acid
analysis, patch clamp electrophysiology, electrokinetic-based separation, droplet microfluidics,
dielectrophoresis, biomicrofluidics, and lab-on-a-chip systems for biomedical applications.

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

# Live Forever Club

## How to live long enough to live forever

Longevity, life extension, biological immortality, rejuvenation, living forever... whatever you want
to call it, you're in the right place.

## The Journal of Modern Medical & Dental Sciences

[[Medical Channel]][52]Since its inception in 1994, the Medical Channel Journal has provided the
medical community in Pakistan and abroad with an invaluable service. As one of the leading medical &
dental sciences publications in Pakistan, it has sought to continue the education of medical
students and postgraduates through scientific research, review articles and updates on contemporary
clinical practices while providing an ongoing forum for medical debate. A measure of our stature is
that we are listed in the Index Medicus and duly approved by Pakistan medical & dental council and
Higher Education Commission of Pakistan.

As a general medical journal, the Medical Channel seeks to represent every facet and domain of the
medical profession. In this respect, we rely on the medical community to inform us of any successes
and advances in their particular fields, their grievances, their hopes for the future and ultimately
ways of improving patient care. Medical Education is a two way process and we are dedicated to
improving the content and scope of this journal.

The Medical Channel is more than just a medical journal. It is part of the fabric and culture of
medicine in Pakistan. We want it to be not only educational but also enjoyable to our readers. Any
subjects or topics which impinge on medicine or which you feel are of interest to the medical
community, we openly welcome.

We appreciate contributions from every quarter! Original papers, short reports, case reports,
letters, reviews, observations, criticisms, conference reports, clinical news, and not least medical
musings.
So start writing today!

Prof. Iqbal A. Memon
Editor in Chief

## of mdma

### Leadership

Saved industry jobs and over $30B with device tax repeal

### Mission

Accelerating patient access and improving health outcomes

### Network

Hundreds of companies of all sizes championing MedTech innovation

“As our organization grows and seeks to continue improving patient care, MDMA has been the perfect
partner to help our team overcome regulatory and reimbursement challenges throughout the years.”

Laura Francis | Chief Executive Officer, SI-BONE

“As a past CEO of multiple companies over the years, MDMA has always been a great resource and
valuable partner in our efforts to improve patient outcomes.”

Doug Godshall | Chairman of the Board of Directors, Saluda Medical & Executive Chairman, Galvanize
Therapeutics

“I have been fortunate to lead both large and small companies, and no matter what policy challenges
they faced, I would always want MDMA to be our voice, advocate and partner. The active engagement
with MDMA and collaboration with fellow members is essential for companies of all sizes to improve
patient care and the innovation ecosystem.”

James (Jim) V. Mazzo | Executive Chairman, Neurotech

Accelerating patient access and improving health outcomes

### Network

Hundreds of companies of all sizes championing MedTech innovation

“As our organization grows and seeks to continue improving patient care, MDMA has been the perfect
partner to help our team overcome regulatory and reimbursement challenges throughout the years.”

Laura Francis | Chief Executive Officer, SI-BONE

“As a past CEO of multiple companies over the years, MDMA has always been a great resource and
valuable partner in our efforts to improve patient outcomes.”

Doug Godshall | Chairman of the Board of Directors, Saluda Medical & Executive Chairman, Galvanize
Therapeutics

they faced, I would always want MDMA to be our voice, advocate and partner. The active engagement
with MDMA and collaboration with fellow members is essential for companies of all sizes to improve
patient care and the innovation ecosystem.”

James (Jim) V. Mazzo | Executive Chairman, Neurotech

We believe in the power of asking questions. For every "if only…", in the field of surgical and
medical intervention, we at Meril hope to turn it into a "what if…" with infinite possibilities &
outcomes.

## Explore our FAQ section to learn more.

### Is Simplify free? How do you make money?

We dropped out of college and started Simplify to equip job seekers with the tools they need to put
their best foot forward in the job search. The base version of Simplify and Simplify Copilot –
including unlimited job tracking and autofill – is and will be free forever. We make money by
charging companies to post jobs and promote their openings – we don't sell your data. We also have a
premium subscription called Simplify+ that offers an additional suite of AI features to help you
supercharge your job search.

### How does Simplify work?

Think of Simplify like a personal assistant for your career. When you create a profile, you'll tell
us the skills you have, the types jobs you're looking for, and any dealbreakers (minimum salary,
location, visa sponsorship, etc.). Our AI agent will find you the specific opportunities that fit
you from the millions of positions in our database. When you apply, we'll help you autofill your
application and show you the most important keywords that are missing from your resume. We also have
an AI resume builder that lets you tailor and optimize your resume in seconds. Finally, our tracker
helps you stay organized across all the jobs you've applied to. Ready to see Simplify in action?
Click the teal "Sign-Up" button to get started!

### How does Simplify handle my data?

We're internet users too and place a heavy emphasis and commitment to your privacy. First and

## Explore our FAQ section to learn more.

### Is Simplify free? How do you make money?

We dropped out of college and started Simplify to equip job seekers with the tools they need to put
their best foot forward in the job search. The base version of Simplify and Simplify Copilot –
including unlimited job tracking and autofill – is and will be free forever. We make money by
charging companies to post jobs and promote their openings – we don't sell your data. We also have a
premium subscription called Simplify+ that offers an additional suite of AI features to help you
supercharge your job search.

### How does Simplify work?

Think of Simplify like a personal assistant for your career. When you create a profile, you'll tell
us the skills you have, the types jobs you're looking for, and any dealbreakers (minimum salary,
location, visa sponsorship, etc.). Our AI agent will find you the specific opportunities that fit
you from the millions of positions in our database. When you apply, we'll help you autofill your
application and show you the most important keywords that are missing from your resume. We also have
an AI resume builder that lets you tailor and optimize your resume in seconds. Finally, our tracker
helps you stay organized across all the jobs you've applied to. Ready to see Simplify in action?
Click the teal "Sign-Up" button to get started!

### How does Simplify handle my data?

Smith+Nephew is a portfolio medical technology company focused on the repair, regeneration and
replacement of soft and hard tissue. We exist to restore people's bodies and their self-belief by
using technology to take the limits off living.

[Sports Medicine]

# Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

Explore sports medicine

# Ultimate victory

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

[ Explore orthopaedic reconstruction ][91]

Our mission is to work as a team to save one more life, today and every day. We do this by providing
lifesaving technology to cardiac surgery teams around the world.

### Oxygenation Systems

Terumo introduced the world’s first hollow fiber oxygenator, and continues to lead the way in
innovation and quality.

Terumo’s CDI Systems are the world’s most trusted and used continuous in-line blood gas monitors.
[Learn More →][56]

### Heart-lung Machines

Terumo manufactures the longest running line of commercially available heart-lung machines in the
world, and is a leader in quality systems management.
[Learn More →][57]

### EVH Products

Terumo’s endoscopic vessel harvesting products are designed for safety and efficiency, delivering
quality results to clinicians and patients.
[Learn More →][58]

## Our Doctors

[ ][30]

Internal Medicine

### [James Kingsley, M.D.][31]

Dr. James Kingsley is a caring physician who listens to patients’ symptoms and stories with empathy
and kindness. He founded The Kingsley Clinic to provide high-quality, evidence-based healthcare to
all patients, no matter their background or circumstance.

## What we Treat

If you’re looking for an urgent care nearby, but prefer to avoid exposure to COVID-19 or simply
prefer the convenience of seeing an online doctor, then we can help you at the Kingsley Clinic.  If
you would like to know whether what you need to be seen for can be managed online ask our front desk
for help.  If it is something you are planning to have evaluated at an urgent care center or it’s
something that your primary care physician typically helps you with, then a Kingsley Clinic doctor
can help you.

Our board certified doctors see and treat patients with both new symptoms and chronic medical
conditions.  We can also help with any medication refills or referrals you might need. Our
physicians see pediatric, adult and geriatric patients.

[ Ask a Doctor ][32]
[medical suitcase graphic][medical suitcase graphic]

## Patient Reviews
